nodes.title: Bounded metric $d/(1+d)$ is equivalent to $d$

nodes.summary: A topological space is homogeneous if its homeomorphism group acts transitively.
nodes.title: Homogeneous topological space

nodes.summary: Let $s$ be a preconnected subset of a topological space $X$ and let $A \subseteq X$. If both $s \cap A$ and $s \cap (X \setminus A)$ are nonempty, then $s$ meets the frontier $\partial A = \overline{A} \setminus \operatorname{int} A$ of $A$, that is, $s \cap \partial A$ is nonempty.
nodes.title: A preconnected set meets the frontier of every set it crosses

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a pseudo-extended metric space (distances lie in $[0, \infty]$ and distinct points may be at distance $0$), write $d$ for its extended distance, and let $\varepsilon \in [0, \infty]$. A set $s \subseteq X$ is $\varepsilon$-separated if $\varepsilon \le d(x, y)$ for all distinct points $x, y \in s$.
nodes.title: Non-strictly separated sets

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a topological space and $s \subseteq X$. The sets that can be obtained from $s$ by applying closure and complement finitely many times (including $s$ itself) form a finite family of at most $14$ distinct sets.
nodes.title: Kuratowski's closure-complement theorem

nodes.summary: A proper closed subset of an irreducible set has Krull dimension at least one less than the ambient set.
nodes.title: Krull dimension drops on proper closed subsets of irreducible sets

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
